# WildFloral

> A luxury beauty and haute fashion studio in Hosur featuring master artisans, private chamber sanctums, and elevated doorstep experiences.

## Business Snapshot
- **Brand Name**: WildFloral
- **Tagline**: Beauty & Fashion
- **Category**: Luxury Beauty Salon, Bridal Studio, Haute Couture & Custom Fashion Atelier
- **Address**: 3-1/2, Neela Mega Nagar, 1st Cross, Hosur, Tamil Nadu, 635109, India

- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/wildfloral_beauty_destination
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Sunday, 09:00 AM – 09:00 PM (09:00–21:00) IST
- **Appointments**: Walk-ins and prior reservations welcomed
- **Doorstep Service**: Available across Hosur for bridal and beauty styling

## Core Offerings

### 1. Beauty Services & Bridal Sanctuary
- **Bridal Transformations**: Bespoke bridal makeup, hair styling, pre-bridal skincare rituals, and draping.
- **Hair Styling & Care**: Precision haircuts, styling, coloring, and intensive nourishing hair spa therapies.
- **Skin Therapies**: Rejuvenating facials, skin brightening, and restorative skincare treatments.
- **Doorstep Beauty**: Master artisans delivering salon and bridal services directly at home or event venues in Hosur.

### 2. Haute Fashion & Custom Couture Atelier
- **Custom Outfit Design**: Bespoke ethnic, contemporary, and fusion garments customized to each client's silhouette.
- **Bridal & Occasion Wear**: Handcrafted bridal blouses, designer lehengas, evening gowns, and party ensembles.
- **Precision Tailoring & Measurements**: One-on-one measurement taking, pattern making, and chamber fitting sessions.
- **Personal Styling Consultations**: Fabric curation, color matching, and design advisory tailored around individual aesthetic.
